instruction: A cinematic full shot of four friends standing in a line on a grassy park field. From left to right, the bald man in the dark blue t-shirt (R2) points to the right while talking; the East Asian man in the red t-shirt with a yellow 'T' (R3) looks towards the others; the woman in the dark blue t-shirt with a red 'E' (R4) stands facing left; and the Black woman with a large afro in the red t-shirt with a pink 'A' (R6) gestures with her hands open. They stand on green grass under bright daylight.
elements: R2 points to the right while talking rather than R3 doing the pointing
R6 gestures with her hands open rather than R4 making the open-handed gesture
R3 looks toward the other friends rather than being the one pointing or gesturing
R4 stands facing left toward the group
R2, R3, R4, and R6 stand together in a line on a grassy park field
